name: screenshot-annotator
title: Screenshot Annotator
description: Capture a screen region, annotate with hotkeys, copy to clipboard.
author: ryan

commands.name: annotate
commands.title: Annotate Screenshot
commands.description: Capture a region, annotate with hotkeys, copy to clipboard.

commands.name: copy-text
commands.title: Copy Text from Screen
commands.description: Capture a region, OCR it, copy the text to the clipboard.

commands.name: annotate-clipboard
commands.title: Annotate Clipboard
commands.description: Open the image already on the clipboard in Annotator.

commands.name: annotate-delayed
commands.title: Annotate in 3s
commands.description: Wait 3 seconds, then capture a region, for menus that disappear.

commands.name: annotate-fullscreen
commands.title: Annotate Full Screen
commands.description: Capture the display under the cursor, then annotate.

commands.name: annotate-last-region
commands.title: Annotate Last Region
commands.description: Recapture the last region without the crosshair, then annotate.

commands.name: reopen
commands.title: Reopen Last Shot
commands.description: Open the last screenshot and its marks again.

commands.name: settings
commands.title: Annotator Settings
commands.description: Open Annotator settings. Does not start a capture.

preferences.name: annotatorPath
preferences.title: Annotator binary
preferences.description: Optional development binary. Raycast uses /Applications/Annotator.app when that app is installed.

scripts.build: ray build -e dist -o dist && cp dist/*.js dist/*.js.map .
